features:
CLASSIC MUFFIN MIX: Banana nut muffins made with delicious walnuts are home-baked treats that are quick for families on the go

QUICK AND EASY: Just add one simple ingredient, bake and enjoy

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare this muffin mix as is or explore Betty Crocker's creative dessert recipes the whole family will love

FLUFFY MUFFINS: Enjoy the fluffy, banana-filled taste

CONTAINS: 6.4 oz (Pack of 9)
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Dextrose, Palm Oil, Walnuts, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Modified Corn Starch, Toasted Wheat Germ, Salt, DATEM, Color Added, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Nonfat Milk. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
